D5/S1/FixedPoints/FiniteContractingStabi.name: D5.S1.FixedPoints.FiniteContractingStability.finite_contracting_updates_stabilize
D5/S1/FixedPoints/FiniteContractingStabi.signature: theorem finite_contracting_updates_stabilize {X : Type*} [Finite X] (U : Set X → Set X) (hU : ∀ A : Set X, U A ⊆ A) (S : ℕ → Set X) (hS : ∀ n : ℕ, S (n + 1) = U (S n)) : (∃ N ≤ (S 0).ncard, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → S n = S N) ∧ {n : ℕ | S (n + 1) ≠ S n}.ncard ≤ (S 0).ncard
